desc:
🎲 Roll for anime characters, build your fighters, and take down your opponents! ⚔️

🎲 Roll for powerful anime characters and collect different rarities. Build your fighters by upgrading their Attack, Ability, Agility and Durability to create the perfect build.

🥊 FIGHT other players and test your builds in battle. Use your character’s abilities and stats to overpower your opponents.
👑 COLLECT rare characters and keep rolling for stronger fighters.
💪 BUILD YOUR FIGHTERS by upgrading their Attack, Ability, Agility and Durability.
🍀 BUY LUCK to improve your chances of rolling rarer characters.
🪑 COLLECT CHAIRS & SKINS to customize your character and show off your style.
🔥 MASTER YOUR BUILDS by creating different combinations of stats and abilities.
📖 COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION by discovering every character and rarity.
🏆 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS and prove you have the strongest fighters.
